item.text: I kept an old coat for years, though it had long since become too small. One day, searching its pockets, I found a faded cinema ticket. I could not remember the film, only the friend beside me—their laughter, the easy warmth of that evening. I placed the ticket carefully in a drawer, where it could keep its small secret. Then I donated the coat, letting the fabric go while keeping the memory.
